name: passage-07-no-outline
description: A packet with no outline has no heading, so no passage is admitted. A span in a reference is not at a heading, because the outline is of the document. A candidate with only an outside item has no evidence (SPEC §4.17).
document:
4 Payment

4.1 Rent
The rent is $900 for each month.

4.2 Fees
The late fee is $25.

4.2.1 Waiver
The owner can waive the fee.

4.3 Deposit
The deposit is $500.

5 Term
The term is 12 months.
